assay_run.method: Aggregate Figure 4B assay of Day-3 cartilage-side supernatants. SensoLyte 520 Generic MMP Activity Kit; undiluted samples activated with 1 mM APMA for 40 min at 37 °C, then incubated with substrate for 45 min. Fluorescence excitation/emission: 490/520 nm. The figure reports n = 13; no individual donor-to-supernatant/plate crosswalk is supplied.
